title: Evolve CIMA GR dealer build photo set
publisher: XHS dealer post; publisher authority unverified
notes: Dealer photo set of an Evolve CIMA GR in a crackle turquoise finish with SRAM Red AXS. The post claims a 750 g unpainted size M frame, six sizes, and reinforcement over the CIMA road frame with 1.2% head-tube and 7.5% bottom-bracket stiffness gains; these are seller-reported claims, not measurements.

capture.scope: Archived public post; the selected photos were reviewed from the original files, which remain outside Git.
